messages.subject: [r-inla] Failure of spatio-temporal modeling based on binomial
parts:
Dear Prof Rue,

Many thanks for your quick response and revised r-code. I tried to run the revised code on my MacBook Pro Laptop M2 as well as in Windows 10, after inserting the codes for 'lunif' and 'sdunif' priors for LCAR, as these were missing in your revised code. Unfortunately, while it was running fine without any issue for all the models  in the Windows 10 Os, it did not work well with Mac OS. In Mac, the programme was running for more than 2 hours with more than 3000 function evaluations without stopping. 

I do not know if I had not installed R and R-Inla correctly in my Mac Pro. Kindly, correct me if I am wrong, or if there are any bugs in the updated versions of both R and INLA. I solicit your advice for correct installation of R and R-INLA in Mac OS

I would highly appreciate help in resolving this issue in the Mca OS. 

System configs are:

chip: Apple M2 Pro
memory: 16 GB
mac OS: Ventura ver 13.4.1

In Mac, I have installed R-4.3.1-arm64.pkg for apple silicon (M1/M2) macs. Is this the correct R version for Mac OS with Venturra ver 13.4.1 and INLA version 23.08.08. or should I use R-4.3.1-x86-64.pkg for Intel Macs. Please advice.

Thanks and regards
S. Subramanian
